data.gender_notes: Raashida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Small, great, little one. Derived from the Arabic root 'rashad' which means 'to guide'. A name for a little girl who is believed to be a source of guidance and support for others. The name Raashida carries the meaning “Small, great, little one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raashida usually hope their child will grow to embody small, great, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raashida total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
